Environment art of the crowd games (city square, street, props, ambient animals)
Downloaded unchanged except for the file names. Each entry below names the files, the authors,
the license we use them under, and where they come from. Where a page offers several licenses,
the one named here is the one we chose (never CC-BY-SA or GPL).

LPC Modern Streets
  Files: street-sidewalk.png (sidewalk_terrain.png), street-road.png (base_road_tile.png),
         street-road-cracked.png (cracked_road.png), street-cracks.png (cracks_transparent.png),
         street-gutter.png (rain_gutter_terrain.png), street-gutter-drains.png (rain_gutter_drain.png),
         street-markings.png (traffic_markings.png), street-manhole.png (manhole_and_cover.png),
         street-cones.png (traffic_cones.png), street-trash-bins.png (trash_bins.png),
         street-traffic-lights.png (traffic_lights.png), street-sign-poles.png (sign_poles.png),
         street-sign-bases.png (traffic_sign_base.png), street-sign-pictograms.png (traffic_signs_pictograms.png)
  License: CC0
  Authors: Faufilage
  https://opengameart.org/content/lpc-modern-streets

LPC Revised (4-Season Terrain), terrain, trees, bushes, flowers and water effects
  Files: grass.png (Terrain/Grass (Summer).png), water-pond-anim.png (Terrain/Grass-Shallows (Summer).png),
         tree-canopies.png (Terrain Objects/Trees, Generic.png), tree-trunks.png (Terrain Objects/Trees, Trunks.png),
         tree-shadows.png (Terrain Objects/Trees, Generic - Shadows.png),
         bush-leafy.png (Terrain Objects/Bush - Seasonal A.png), bush-round.png (Terrain Objects/Bush - Seasonal B.png),
         bush-cypress.png (Terrain Objects/Bush - Evergreen A.png), flowers.png (Terrain Objects/Flowers - Garden.png),
         water-sparkle-anim.png (FX/Water Reflections.png), water-ripple-anim.png (FX/WaterRipple.png)
  License: OGA-BY 3.0
  Authors: Eliza Wyatt (ElizaWy, DeathsDarling), Lanea Zimmerman (Sharm), Hyptosis, bluecarrot16
  Notes: grass, water and trees originally by Lanea Zimmerman, edited, animated and recolored by Eliza Wyatt;
         bushes partly by Hyptosis; flowers by bluecarrot16 (rose bush, CC0), Sharm and Hyptosis, recolored by
         Eliza Wyatt; water effects by Eliza Wyatt. Hyptosis allowed his CC-BY 3.0 work to be used under OGA-BY 3.0.
  https://opengameart.org/content/lpc-revised-4-season-terrain
  https://github.com/ElizaWy/LPC/tree/main/Terrain
  https://github.com/ElizaWy/LPC/tree/main/FX
  https://opengameart.org/content/liberated-pixel-cup-lpc-base-assets-sprites-map-tiles
